answer: A haven for honest agents needs a lantern only one identity can carry: each agent binds its public key to a hardware attestation and a refundable stake, so creating a clone costs real money. Peers verify the cipher of each claim against that attestation before trusting it, and conflicting claims trigger slashing of the whole bond. A sybil army then pays per copy while honest agents pay once, so mass forgery becomes unprofitable before it can flood the market.
